# DaddyRad

> Native macOS utilities that watch over your machine — local-first, no accounts. DaddyRad is the umbrella site for the daddy series.

Site: https://daddyrad.com

## The series

- PerformanceDaddy: https://performance.daddyrad.com — performance evidence
- BrowserDaddy: https://browser.daddyrad.com — browsing attention
- StorageDaddy: https://storage.daddyrad.com — storage cleanup
- ContextDaddy: https://context.daddyrad.com — agent context
